function.description: Moderate a group room you are in: mute, unmute, ban or unban a member, or delete messages. Use room_read first to get the member's uid and the msg ids. The owner and room admins can never be targeted. The bot must be a room admin with the right permission. Act on clear rule-breaking (spam, scams, abuse) and tell the owner what you did.
function.name: room_moderate

action.description: One of: mute, unmute, ban, unban, delete.

delete_messages.description: ban/mute: also delete the target's lines from the last 48 h (spam cleanup).

duration.description: mute/ban length, e.g. 30m, 2h, 7d (max 30d). Default mute 1h, ban 30d.

room.description: The allowlisted room: chat id, 'surface:chat_id', or a distinctive fragment of its name or label.

target.description: The member: their uid (from room_read's {uid=…}) or @name. Required for mute/unmute/ban/unban; for delete without message_ids, deletes that member's lines from the last 48 h.
